description: As a forensic analyst, I can carve EVTX records from a file path and verify structural integrity of a file so I can process evidence on disk without loading it entirely into memory
steps: carve_from_file(path) on a valid EVTX file path returns Ok(CarveResult) with at least one chunk
carve_from_file(path) on a path that does not exist returns an Err
verify_integrity(path) on a structurally sound EVTX file returns Ok with an empty Vec<AntiForensicIndicator>
verify_integrity(path) on an EVTX file with a tampered chunk header checksum returns Ok with at least one ChunkChecksumMismatch indicator
verify_integrity(path) on a path that does not exist returns an Err
